title: Lantern-Lipped Lollopfish
statement: A round, velvety fish the color of toasted marshmallow, the Lollopfish drifts through a tank of tea-brown water and sunken teacups, tipping slowly from side to side as it swims. A soft lantern dangles from its lower lip, and it dims the light whenever a visitor comes near, as if politely lowering its voice.
